Content.Title: Support Rising Beyond Borders
Content.Introduction: Your gift supports work that creates opportunity, strengthens communities and builds more sustainable futures — across education, health and wellbeing, livelihoods and community support.
Content.Image: Upload apps/web/src/assets/rbb-field-kids.jpg (RBB's own field photo, used on the website today) — alt text: A person in a vest printed with the Rising Beyond Borders logo hands a wrapped package to a smiling girl, with other children gathered around; focal point 72% 45%
Content.Context note: A general gift goes where support is needed most across our four program areas. If you would rather support something specific, you can choose an emergency appeal or a campaign below.
\"Why it matters\" paragraphs: Our mission is to empower vulnerable communities with resources, support and opportunities for sustainable growth and lasting change.
Our vision is a world beyond borders where compassion unites people and every individual can thrive in a safe, inclusive and equitable society.

Content.Questions: The site's donation questions (the four below are those questions; choose "This page's own questions" only to change them)

Questions and answers.question: Can I choose what my donation supports?
Questions and answers.answer: Yes. You can give to a specific emergency appeal or campaign from this page, or give where support is needed most — which lets us direct your gift to wherever it can do the most good across our four program areas.

Questions and answers.question: How are donations used?
Questions and answers.answer: Donations support our work across education, health and wellbeing, livelihoods and community support. Our transparency and financial information shows how our work is run and how resources are used.

Questions and answers.question: What if I need to change or ask about a donation?
Questions and answers.answer: Please contact us through our Contact page with the details of your gift, and we will help.

Questions and answers.question: Can I give on behalf of a business or organisation?
Questions and answers.answer: Yes. Organisations can give, and many choose to partner with us in other ways too. Get in touch through our Partner With Us page to talk about what would suit you.
